html:
The Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia, FARC, was a communist guerrilla army founded in 1964 and disarmed in 2017. At its height it had perhaps 20,000 fighters and controlled large parts of the countryside.

It grew from peasant self-defence groups of La Violencia. After the army attacked their enclave at Marquetalia in 1964, they formed a guerrilla under Manuel Marulanda. From the 1980s the FARC paid for its war through kidnapping, extortion and taxing the coca and cocaine trade.

Its war with the state and right-wing paramilitaries is the core of the Colombian conflict. Kidnappings, like that of the politician Ingrid Betancourt, held from 2002 to 2008, made it notorious. After years of talks, it signed the peace agreement of 2016 and became a political party in Colombia.
sum: The Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia, FARC, was a communist guerrilla army founded in 1964 and disarmed in 2017. At its height it had perhaps 20,000 fighters and controlled large parts of the countryside.
